The cleanest direct exposure is still contractors that own scarce lineworker capacity, but the more Serenity-relevant underfollowed lane is suppliers or platforms that can reduce crew hours, speed installation, or automate inspection. MYRG is a smaller direct labor-capacity owner versus Quanta. ONDS is a speculative micro-cap field-automation/drone candidate requiring proof of utility adoption. The investable universe for true lineworker productivity tooling appears thin, so later layers should prioritize deployment proof, utility adoption, repeat orders, safety certification, and whether the productivity product is material to revenue.
